rv.q: However, 'Carmen,' one of the opera canon's hoariest chestnuts, proved impervious to Ms. Cracknell's efforts.
With Leonard as the central human element, this is a superb revival.

All of this to say, this production of "Carmen" was confusing and the use of high-power LEDs, projected from the stage and at the audience, detoured one from even wanting to watch what was happening on stage.

cn.t: Cracknell's Carmen revival at the Met draws mixed reactions, with critics divided on the production's staging choices. Strong vocal performances clash with concerns about ambiguous plotting and heavy LED lighting effects.
